description: This file defines the declaration of the LocalInstanceGroup class within the cuttlefish namespace, including its methods, members, and associated data structures. It provides interfaces for managing and querying groups of local instances related to Android virtual devices, including serialization, deserialization, and status fetching functionalities.

classes.name: LocalInstanceGroup
classes.description: A class representing a group of local Android virtual device instances with methods to manage their lifecycle and state.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a LocalInstanceGroup from a group proto.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserialize a JSON representation into a LocalInstanceGroup object.

methods.name: const std::string & GroupName() const
methods.description: Returns the name of the instance group.

methods.name: const std::string & HomeDir() const
methods.description: Returns the home directory path for the group.

methods.name: SetHomeDir
methods.description: Sets the home directory path for the group.

methods.description: Returns the path to host artifacts.

methods.description: Returns the product output path.

methods.name: SetProductOutPath
methods.description: Sets the product output path.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start timestamp of the group.

methods.description: Sets the start timestamp of the group.
